audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t itemization text says 'her duo's sustain' as 'his' — Janna is female (champ-gender.js) so the pronoun for the enemy must be 'her'.
audit.why: The owner is addressed as 'you'; any third-person pronoun refers to the enemy, and Janna is on the female list.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Howling Gale as matchup-defining but carries no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Howling Gale is a 14s-cooldown charge-up; naming the real number lets the reader time the bait-then-commit window instead of just being told it's important.
missingInteractions flags Monsoon's heal needing Grievous Wounds timing — report[8].t already carries 'Add anti-heal early into her duo's sustain', so this is covered once the pronoun is fixed.
